assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq, HiSeq, 50 bp SE) of bilateral dorsal hippocampus, 12-week-old male C57BL/6J mice, collected 1 h after a subthreshold 3-min OLM acquisition (S4.2.5.p1, S4.2.6.p1)
sample_inclusion: OLM-trained mice of the six exercise patterns (n=10 each in GEO); RIN>9 (S4.2.6.p1). The GEO 'HC' samples (0-0-0, no OLM) are not part of the paper's described RNA-seq contrasts.
primary_estimand: Effect of each exercise pattern versus sedentary control on dorsal-hippocampus gene expression during OLM consolidation (1 h post acquisition); focus on 14-0-0 and 14-7-2, the patterns that enable long-term memory (S2.2.p1, S4.2.8.p1)
repeated_measure_unit: none (one sample per mouse, independent groups)
batch: tissue collected over two separate days with equal n per group (S4.2.5.p1) = GEO 'harvest cohort'
paper_method: Cyber-T Bayesian-regularized t-test, each exercise group vs sedentary pairwise, on FPKM (S4.2.8.p1); linear regression models as a secondary check (Fig. S2)
paper_results: Per-group DEG counts are only shown graphically (Fig. 2C/D), not stated in text; intersection of up-regulated genes in 14-0-0 and 14-7-2 = 21 genes incl. Bdnf and Acvr1c (S2.2.p1, Data Table S1); Acvr1c not up in 14-7-0 (S2.2.p1)
